notes.title: New OPUS game "OPUS: Prism Peak" teaser revealed!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066045/a0bdfba395768fef3fc57ba53208176a1f6d141b.png[/img]

OPUS: Echo of Starsong followup title OPUS: Prism Peak is a narrative adventure where your choices lead to divergent endings. Play as a photographer lost in an ethereal realm, and unveil its mysteries with your camera to find a way home.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066045/fedcaf5c9e7c4b1163358a2d418962c127ca32ab.jpg[/img]

"Capture the moment, then learn to let go."

Check out the shiny new teaser and remember to WISHLIST + FOLLOW! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1947910/Project_MOUNTAIN/

We hope this announcement kicks off your new year with something heartwarming to look forward to!

notes.title: OPUS: Echo of Starsong key role revealed!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066045/4d00346b93b560d2a1b11550ee08c48c97aa3d2f.png[/img]

Hey there, this is the crew behind Echo of Starsong. Last time, we talked about Caves - the ancient ruins people from every corner of the galaxy were fighting to control.

Today, we're introducing another key group - the Witches. These servants of faith were conscripted by the military for their ability to sense the life energy of caves across space, making them perfect radars among the battlefield, and the harbingers of death...


👉 [url=https://www.opus-echo-of-starsong.sigono.com/?utm_medium=News&utm_source=Steam&utm_campaign=422SP]Subscribe[/url] to our newsletter for more!

notes.title: OPUS: Echo of Starsong | Official Game Teaser Trailer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=D1eCVnOGWYM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]“Lend me your voice, so that I may reach you across the waters of time and space.”
[/h2]

Flowing throughout the asteroids of an ancient exosystem, is a mysterious life force that only the gifted singer can trace. Those of the Far East, who seek out its channels, know them by the name of Rivers.

OPUS: Echo of Starsong is a mythical Asian space opera about a boy in search of the fabled Rivers, and the girl who lent him her voice.

Coming in 2021
Check out our website for more👉https://bit.ly/3exSPwt
